scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run test:admin && npm run test:shared
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:server -- --coverage && npm run test:client -- --coverage && npm run test:admin -- --coverage
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "npm run test:server -- --watch" "npm run test:client -- --watch" "npm run test:admin -- --watch"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:production: npm run build:client:production && npm run build:admin:production
scripts.build:client:production: cd client && cp .env.production .env && npm run build
scripts.build:admin:production: cd admin && cp .env.production .env && npm run build
